plan.notes: Sequence transcribed from the official Program Guide PDF (Program Guide link on the official program page; https://atc-website-test.azurewebsites.net/media/ungnvxnt/mechanical-cad-operator-certificate.pdf, retrieved 2026-10-01). The PDF template header prints '2023-2024'; the guide is the currently published program guide and its program name, sequence, and 25-credit total match the current official programs listing (Mechanical Drafting & Design Certificate, 25 credits). The guide titles the award 'Mechanical CAD Operator certificate'; the listing titles the certificate 'Mechanical Drafting & Design' certificate — both describe the same 25-credit award, and the guide cross-references the related AAS and 'Mechanical CAD Drafter diploma'. The 25-credit certificate program consists of technical courses designed to develop skills in mechanical drafting; students also receive hands-on training in the computer aided drafting lab (AutoCAD, Inventor, ProE/Creo, and Solidworks). Program starts Fall (August) and Spring (January); students who start in the spring will need longer to complete due to course prerequisites. Students must earn a cumulative 2.0 GPA or higher to be eligible for graduation. Some courses in this program may require a prerequisite; see course descriptions for more details.

courses.choice_note: Per the official program guide: MECH 2064 Introduction to Inventor OR MECH 2084 Introduction to ProE/Creo (4 credits).
